title: kbmon's sessions.orphan alert names an orphan of any age, so the receipt's ALERT line and kbask name a 1-second orphan the panel hides
goal: The sessions.orphan alert takes ST-crmdmgb4's 60 s rule: an orphan younger than 60 s raises no alert, one at least 60 s old still does, and the alert text says 'with a live child' when it has one, as the panel line does (gate g1 of ST-crmdmgb4, changed at the SP-uh5h46fm review)
